sentences.text: Hello everyone. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Emili. In this podcast we speak slowly.
We use simple English. We repeat ideas.
Today we travel to Eastern Europe. We go to Bulgaria.
Our city today is Plovdiv. Plovdiv is calm. Plovdiv is very old.
Plovdiv is full of history and life. Please sit comfortably. Please listen slowly.
Let us begin. Part 2 Bulgaria in Simple English.
Bulgaria is a country in Europe. It is in the Balkan region.
Bulgaria has mountains. Bulgaria has rivers. People value family.
People value tradition. Life feels simple. Life feels real.
Plovdiv shows Bulgarian culture very well at 3. Where is Plovdiv?
Plovdiv is in the south of Bulgaria. It is one of the oldest cities in Europe.
The city is built on hills. There are seven hills.
The land feels warm. The city feels open. Plovdiv is easy to walk. Everything feels close.
Part 4 Plovdiv has clear seasons. Summer is hot. The sun is strong.
Autumn is soft. Colors change slowly. Winter is cold.
Snow comes sometimes. Spring feels fresh. Life returns.
The weather shapes daily life. One of the oldest cities in Europe.
Plovdiv is very old. People lived here thousands of years ago.
Thracians lived here. Romans lived here. Ottomans lived here.
Bulgarians lived here. Each culture left marks. Each culture added stories.
Time feels deep in Plovdiv. Part 6, the Old Town.
The Old Town is special. It is quiet and beautiful. Houses are colorful.
Windows are wooden. Streets are narrow. Streets are stone. People walk slowly.
They look around. The Old Town feels like a living museum.
Part 7, Roman Heritage. Plovdiv has Roman history. You can see it clearly.
There is a Roman theater. It is very old. People still use it.
Music plays there. The past is not dead. The past is alive.
History and today meet here. Part 8, daily life of people.
People in Plovdiv live calmly. They wake up early. They go to work.
They meet friends. Cafes are important. Talking is important.
Life is not rushed. Moments are enjoyed. Part 9, food and taste.
Vegetables are fresh. Bread is warm. Soups are common. Meat is shared.
People eat together. Food means family. Eating is a daily ritual.
Part 10, art, culture and youth. Plovdiv loves art.
There are galleries. Young people create. Ideas grow.
Music fills streets. Festivals bring life. The city feels creative.
The city feels open. Culture feels natural here.
Part 11, nature and hills. The hills are important. They shape the city.
People walk uphill. They rest and look. From the hills, views are wide.
The city looks peaceful. Nature gives balance. Silence gives rest.
Part 12, the soul of Plovdiv. And goodbye, Plovdiv is ancient.
Plovdiv is gentle. It is not loud. It is not fast. It teaches patience.
It teaches depth. History walks with people. Life flows slowly.
